corpusSources.name: ngspice
corpusSources.redistributionDecision: Allowed. Upstream COPYING applies Modified BSD to source code, tests, and examples except listed paths; none of these fixtures is in an exception path.
corpusSources.mechanicalAdaptation: The terminal newline is omitted during ingestion; all circuit content and internal line endings are otherwise preserved. No circuit values or tolerances are changed.

corpusSources.name: Berkeley SPICE3f5 examples
corpusSources.redistributionDecision: Allowed by Berkeley's SPICE grant when its Regents copyright notice and two warranty paragraphs appear in all copies. The required notice is retained byte-for-byte; the mirror maintainer's separate BSD-3-Clause notice is also retained but is not the provenance basis for these fixtures.
corpusSources.mechanicalAdaptation: None. Every .cir fixture is copied byte-for-byte from the pinned mirror revision.

corpusSources.name: Xyce Regression Suite primitive-device tests
corpusSources.redistributionDecision: Allowed under GPL-3.0-or-later. The upstream copyright and licence notice is retained byte-for-byte and the complete GPLv3 text is distributed alongside the fixtures.
corpusSources.mechanicalAdaptation: None. Every .cir fixture is copied byte-for-byte from the pinned Xyce_Regression revision.

corpusSources.name: ahkab test-suite circuits
corpusSources.redistributionDecision: Allowed under GPL-2.0-only. The selected source-form test circuits are distributed verbatim with the upstream project notice and complete GPLv2 text.
corpusSources.mechanicalAdaptation: None. Every .ckt fixture is copied byte-for-byte from the pinned ahkab revision.

corpusSources.name: Gnucap regression test circuits
corpusSources.redistributionDecision: Allowed under GPL-3.0-or-later. Selected source-form tests are redistributed verbatim with the tests/MakeList GPL notice and complete GPLv3 text.
corpusSources.mechanicalAdaptation: None. Every .ckt fixture is byte-identical to the pinned Gnucap revision.

metricTransitions: Comparable coverage rose from 20 to 28 analyses and from 13 to 18 fixtures. Eleven newly comparable analyses were added, while the RCA3040 regression removed three prior comparisons.
Matched absolute signals rose from 189 to 253 and samples from 7,384,608 to 7,413,027. Relative signals rose from 178 to 235 and samples from 7,384,277 to 7,410,627.
Excluded zero-reference samples rose from 331 to 2,400 because the newly compared analyses include more exact-zero ngspice reference points.

Absolute max fell from 183.91564521207212 to 90.09458674829554 and absolute RMS fell from 87.25304257950958 to 59.660512653520904 because the failed RCA3040 AC result no longer contributes its v(15) loss. This is not an accuracy improvement.

Relative max rose from 9829734.595793912 to 273625086.91875815 and relative RMS rose from 1160907.113030371 to 131055144.90676585. The new worst signal is v(4) in the corpus-e MOS1 inverter transient.
